description: This file defines the Zend_Json class, which provides static methods for encoding data to JSON and decoding JSON strings into data. It handles JSON serialization and deserialization, using built-in PHP functions if available, or requiring external decoder and encoder classes otherwise.

classes.name: Zend_Json
classes.description: Provides static methods for encoding data to JSON and decoding JSON strings, with optional use of PHP's built-in functions or external decoder/encoder classes.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON-encoded string into PHP data types, using either the built-in json_decode or an external decoder class.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes PHP data into a JSON string, using either the built-in json_encode or an external encoder class.
